# CameraWalk

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/camera_walk.h`](../../../src/view/camera_walk.h) · Described in `data/view.json`

Where the walk of the CameraWalk system is: its line, progress, started and finished.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `start` | `glm::vec2` | x, z of the start of the line |
| `heading` | `float` | radians, as Camera::yaw (0 toward -z) |
| `distance` | `float` | length of the line, m |
| `progress` | `float` | metres along the line |
| `started` | `bool` | false while the terrain, plants, animals and lighting load |
| `finished` | `bool` | the end of the line or of the path is reached |

## Notes

Emplaced by CameraWalk in preinit, written by it only; for tools and tests that wait on the walk.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: CameraWalk. Created by: CameraWalk. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | preinit (emplace), init, tick, look | start / heading / distance in init; started, progress, finished in tick |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
